clips.caption:
A simple beaker picture shows how receiving works.

Kevin Trudeau describes a full beaker and an empty beaker joined by a siphon. Water only flows if the empty one sits below the full one and is empty enough to receive.

He says most people put God in the wrong place, so they pull nothing from the universe. In his view, surrender and praise come first, and then the flow.

Where in your life are you trying to pull without being open to receive?
